preregistration.prior_evidence: EXP-0110 observed exact multi-table creation candidates. Initial-row composition combines previously documented row encoding and data page/map facts; no composed initial-row DAO acceptance is assumed.
preregistration.hypothesis: DAO consumes a composed one-table unindexed image containing positive, negative, and null Long values and nonempty/null Text values, with the same schema and row multiset as a fresh DAO control. The candidate retains the composed page-zero header without insertion counter updates; whether DAO reads that image unchanged is part of this exact-candidate hypothesis.
preregistration.authorization: User authorized DAO experiments and mutations on 2026-09-04. Commit and review the exact SHA-256-pinned plan before one dispatch. A failure after the first CreateDatabase is a scientific result; another dispatch requires a new human decision.

execution.environment: Private local Windows VM, x86 PowerShell, DAO.DBEngine.36. This is development discovery, not hosted support-matrix evidence.
execution.pre_mutation: Host validates every input hash and committed plan; guest verifies its script hash and prepares three hash-checked candidate copies before any CreateDatabase.
execution.per_replica: Create and close a fresh DAO Jet 3 database with table Rows(Id Long, Code Text 8), no indexes, insert three expected rows; open both control and candidate read-only, enumerate schema and snapshot rows, close, compare before/after identities.

decision_rule.observed_accepted: All three controls and candidates have unchanged identities and exactly expected schema and row multiset, with identical replicated endpoint observations.
decision_rule.not_observed_accepted: All three controls pass unchanged with expected semantics, all candidates unchanged and identically fail at one endpoint or yield the same semantic mismatch.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Incomplete job, control failure, changed image, or disagreement between replicas.
decision_rule.validation_rejection: Reject report for mismatched plan/result identity, invalid replica inventory, candidate starting pin mismatch, or retained image identity mismatch.

evidence_boundary: Only the exact pinned image and schema/row endpoints. No general initial-row compatibility, multiple data pages, indexed inserts, long values, existing-database mutation, or hosted support-matrix claims.
retention: Retain result.json, canonical report.json, logs and all candidate/control MDBs locally. Never commit MDB bytes. Add one additive EXP outcome from validated report after acquisition.
